$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天府獨坐巳亥，《深造講義》p.200。

basis.quote: 须视其为祥和抑为权术

rules.text: 所會的多是權力和欲望之星，你的天府保守性較小。
rules.en: The stars you meet are mostly of power and desire, so your Tian Fu is less conservative.

source.quote: 因而独坐的天府保守性亦较小

rules.text: 祥和的天府，表面看不出重大建樹，其實不知不覺間已建立事功，心境安定。
rules.en: A peaceable Tian Fu shows no great achievements on the surface, yet quietly builds real results, with a settled mind.

source.quote: 其实不知不觉间已建立事功

rules.text: 多思慮的一面較重：常常騰挪變化，結果卻所得不多，心裡也多憂。
rules.en: The overthinking side is stronger: much manoeuvring with little to show for it, and more worry inside.
rules.edit: 原書「權術」改稱多思慮，與骨架章兩頭名一致。

rules.text: 你的天府與祿存同宮，雖祥和，氣魄卻不大。
rules.en: Your Tian Fu shares the palace with Lu Cun: peaceable, but without much scope.

rules.text: 會照的武曲化祿，令你更祥和，待人寬厚。
rules.en: Wu Qu transformed by Lu in your trine makes you more peaceable and generous with people.

rules.text: 會照的貪狼化祿，令你更祥和，待人寬厚。
rules.en: Tan Lang transformed by Lu in your trine makes you more peaceable and generous with people.

rules.text: 會照的武曲化忌，是你最不宜的配合。
rules.en: Wu Qu in Obstruction in your trine is the combination you suit least.
